dataItems.name: Customer order records

dataItems.description: Event id, order reference, status, customer email and the card's last four digits.

dataItems.description: Gateway request logs, application logs and the bastion auth log; carry customer email addresses and bearer tokens.

dataItems.name: Admin commands
dataItems.description: Replay, reindex and cancel requests to the admin listener.

dataItems.name: Engineer SSH keys
dataItems.description: Engineers' SSH key authentication to the shared ops account.

dataFlows.description: Orders and checkout requests with the access token.

dataFlows.description: Engineers sign in to the shared ops account with a key.

dataFlows.description: Replay and reindex calls to the admin listener, no authentication.

dataFlows.name: Admin database session
dataFlows.description: psql as orders_admin through an SSH tunnel.

dataFlows.name: Bastion auth log
dataFlows.description: auth.log forwarded to the log platform.

dataFlows.description: The gateway forwards to the orders API over plain HTTP.

dataFlows.description: The orders API creates charges with the card data.

dataFlows.description: The orders API fetches the identity provider's signing keys.

dataFlows.name: Orders queries
dataFlows.description: Orders and stored-card reads and writes, sslmode=disable.

dataFlows.name: Orders API logs
dataFlows.description: Application logs, including customer email addresses.

dataFlows.name: Payment status webhook
dataFlows.description: HMAC-signed payment status events from the vendor.

dataFlows.name: Payment event writes
dataFlows.description: Payment events and order status updates, verify-full TLS.

dataFlows.name: Webhook receiver logs
dataFlows.description: Application logs, including customer email addresses.
